exercises.question: Choose the sentence that correctly emphasizes the time of the meeting.

options.A: It was on Monday when we had the meeting.
options.B: It was Monday that we had the meeting.
options.C: What we had the meeting was Monday.
options.D: Monday was what we had the meeting.

exercises.correct_option: It was Monday that we had the meeting.
exercises.explanation: The cleft pattern is 'It was + focus + that + clause': 'It was Monday that we had the meeting.'
